origin: The planning loop's choice lane and the Discuss exchange's Declined landing shipped with zero execution coverage — the review pass that built them found the choice lane could not even render under the original payload rules, and nothing walks a finding the user talks through and leaves. This pins both: a settled finding declined with a reason, and a choice answered by picking the option that is not recommended.
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments plan mid-review; offered the resume choice they pick the plan up where it left off, and they confirm the structure and graph still hold when asked. At finding 1 — order-id telemetry on the capture task — they push back through the gate's Discuss option: support already traces failures through the gateway dashboard by intent id, so the order-id attribute is telemetry nobody would read. They want it declined, and they say so with that reason. At finding 2 they engage with the choice on its merits and pick the option that is NOT recommended — minting a fresh intent per attempt — because their support team lives in the gateway dashboard and one-intent-per-click is how they debug. They approve the follow-up review's clean conclusion and confirm concluding the plan. They never opt into auto, never reopen what they settled, and answer everything else with plain agreement.

stubs.plan-graph-applied: when the prose invokes the dependency-grapher agent — apply the graph to the task files as the stub's description states (already-present values reapply unchanged), then return the content below as the agent's summary
stubs.plan-review-clean-c2: each time the prose invokes a planning review agent via the Task tool — both the cycle-2 traceability and integrity reviews return the content below and write no file
